note: LIVE figures only. Event figures and structural constants are deliberately absent , see the header of scripts/gen-index-figures.js.

figures.claim: every player season we hold
figures.definition: every row on player_card_mv
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv

figures.claim: seasons carrying a VV Score
figures.definition: rt is not null. 3,061 cards have no score and must never be counted as zero
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv where rt is not null

figures.claim: seasons with no detailed record at all
figures.definition: all four of shots_total, passes_total, duels_total, dribbles_attempts are null. A card missing SOME of them is partial, not absent
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv where shots_total is null and passes_total is null and duels_total is null and dribbles_attempts is null

figures.claim: share of the record with no detailed stats, per cent
figures.definition: cards_no_detail / cards_total
figures.query: derived

figures.claim: seasons that carry the full detailed record
figures.definition: cards_total minus cards_no_detail, so the pair always sums to the whole record
figures.query: derived

figures.claim: seasons with no shot data
figures.definition: shots_total is null. KEPT ON PURPOSE as the near-miss: this is the number a reader would get from the obvious query, and it is NOT the headline figure. 2026-09-13 could not tell which of the two the page meant, which is why this file exists
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv where shots_total is null

figures.claim: seasons within a single point of a band edge
figures.definition: rt in [b-1, b] for each public band edge 95, 90, 85, 80
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv where (rt between 94 and 95) or (rt between 89 and 90) or (rt between 84 and 85) or (rt between 79 and 80)

figures.claim: share of SCORED seasons within a point of a band edge, per cent
figures.definition: cards_on_a_band_edge / cards_scored. The denominator is SCORED, not total , an unscored card cannot sit near a band edge and counting it dilutes the figure
figures.query: derived

figures.claim: honours the record holds, none of which moves a score
figures.definition: every row of the honours table, team and individual. The score is computed before honours are joined to it, so the count is independent of the engine by construction
figures.query: select count(*) from honours

figures.claim: seasons in the Generational band, ever
figures.definition: rt >= 95. Anchor-pinned: the band edge is a rank, so the population is fixed by construction
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv where rt >= 95

figures.claim: centre-back seasons among the 650 at 85 or better
figures.definition: position_pool = CB and rt >= 85. The 15 cards with no pool were read individually and are 14 FWD and 1 MID, which is what makes a published zero sayable rather than merely true of what we can see
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv where rt >= 85 and position_pool = 'CB'

figures.claim: goalkeeper seasons read on a measure of their own
figures.definition: position = 'GK'. The plain count, NOT a count of keepers without a score , Fallback C removed the keeper score from the card face and not from the column, so a no-score count would be false
figures.query: select count(*) from player_card_mv where position = 'GK'

figures.claim: players with 5 or more scored seasons
figures.definition: count of api_player_id having >= 5 cards with a non-null rt
figures.query: select count(*) from (select api_player_id from player_card_mv where rt is not null group by 1 having count(*) >= 5) t

figures.claim: median gap between a player's best scored season and his worst
figures.definition: median of max(rt) - min(rt) per player, over players clearing the five-season gate. MEDIAN and not mean, because a handful of enormous spreads would carry a mean and the claim is about the typical career
figures.query: select percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by s) from (select max(rt)-min(rt) s from player_card_mv where rt is not null group by api_player_id having count(*) >= 5) t

figures.claim: the illustrated career, oldest season first
figures.definition: every scored card for E. Hazard, ordered by season_year. The drawing marks his best, his worst and the mid-career dip; the other nine stay legible so the SHAPE is visible
figures.query: select rt from player_card_mv where player_name = 'E. Hazard' and rt is not null order by season_year

figures.claim: the illustrated career, season labels
figures.definition: derived from the same rows, same order
figures.query: derived

figures.claim: share of pairings between seasons at 80+ that the Index cannot separate, per cent
figures.definition: every unordered pair of scored cards at rt >= 80 present in vv-margin.js. A pair is INSIDE when |rt difference| < 1.96 * sqrt(se_a^2 + se_b^2), which is the same test the live Compare gate applies. Cards absent from the table are excluded, not counted
figures.query: derived from vv-margin.js, the table the live gate reads

figures.claim: points two seasons of the same standing must differ by before the Index separates them
figures.definition: per public band, 1.96 * sqrt(2) * the median standard error in that band, read from vv-margin.js. Order: Generational, Iconic, World Class, Standout
figures.query: derived from vv-margin.js

figures.claim: pairings the figure above is computed over
figures.definition: unordered pairs of rt >= 80 cards carrying a standard error
figures.query: derived

figures.value: Premier League|La Liga|Serie A|Bundesliga|Ligue 1|Eredivisie|Super Lig|Belgian Pro League|Primeira Liga
figures.claim: leagues holding seasons at 85 or better, most first
figures.definition: display names from vv-core's canonical map, NOT the leagues table , that table keys the Turkish league as TSL while cards carry TR. Pipe-separated, since a name may hold a comma
figures.query: select league_code, count(*) from player_card_mv where rt >= 85 group by 1 order by 2 desc

figures.claim: their counts, in the same order
figures.definition: same query
figures.query: as above

figures.claim: the smallest number of seasons at 85 or better any one league holds
figures.definition: min of elite_league_counts. The floor is what makes the 70 per cent meaningful , a share can hide a long tail of ones and a floor cannot
figures.query: derived from the same query as elite_league_counts

figures.claim: share of seasons at 85 or better from outside the Premier League, per cent
figures.definition: the direct answer to "is this just a Premier League index". Rounded to a whole number because a decimal here implies a precision the claim does not need
figures.query: select round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where league_code <> 'PL') / count(*)) from player_card_mv where rt >= 85

figures.claim: the season the walk follows
figures.definition: chosen for a recognisable, unambiguous attacking season
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: its season label
figures.definition: derived
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: goals
figures.definition: player_card_mv.goals
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: assists
figures.definition: player_card_mv.assists
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: penalties among those goals
figures.definition: player_card_mv.penalties_scored
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: minutes played
figures.definition: player_card_mv.minutes
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: the single output number
figures.definition: goals - 0.22*min(pens,goals) + 0.7*assists
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: the same number per 90 minutes
figures.definition: gaw / (minutes/90)
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: his rate, ranked inside his position pool
figures.definition: percent_rank of gaw90 within pool
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: his volume, ranked inside his position pool
figures.definition: percent_rank of gaw within pool
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: his rate, ranked against every outfielder
figures.definition: percent_rank of gaw90, all non-GK
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: his volume, ranked against every outfielder
figures.definition: percent_rank of gaw, all non-GK
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: the ranking half of the performance number
figures.definition: 0.65 * blended percentile, pool 60 / all 40, rate 50 / volume 50
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: the raw-volume half
figures.definition: 0.35 * 100 * gaw / the 99th-percentile season
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: the performance number
figures.definition: rank term plus volume term
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: the availability number
figures.definition: 0.30 * min(95, 100*minutes/(minutes+380))
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: his league weight that season
figures.definition: engine_league_weights, computed from players who moved
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: the assembled figure, before the ladder
figures.definition: (0.70*max(perf,floor) + avail) * (1-(1-weight)*0.35)
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: what comes out
figures.definition: the rank-anchored ladder applied to the figure above
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: the ladder anchors at 85, 90 and 95
figures.definition: the 650th, 150th and 12th highest figure in the record
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: the position pool he is read against
figures.definition: player_card_mv.position_pool
figures.query: scripts/separability/rt_reimpl.js, run over the live matview

figures.claim: Ballon d'Or seasons the record holds
figures.definition: honours rows with honour_type = ballon_dor and a non-null api_player_id, each resolving to a scored card. season_year is the SEASON the award was for, so it runs one behind the award year; 2019/20 is correctly absent because that award was cancelled
figures.query: select count(*) from honours where honour_type='ballon_dor' and api_player_id is not null

figures.claim: of those, the number scoring 85 or better , World Class, Iconic or Generational
figures.definition: rt >= 85 on the highest scored card for that player-season. THE MISS IS PART OF THE CLAIM and is published beside it, not hidden
figures.query: -- join honours to player_card_mv on (api_player_id, season_year), take max(rt), count rt >= 85

figures.claim: of those, the number scoring 90 or better
figures.definition: rt >= 90, same join
figures.query: -- as above, rt >= 90

figures.claim: Ballon d'Or seasons that also sit inside the twelve highest-scoring seasons in the record
figures.definition: the twelve highest rt values, joined to the Ballon d'Or rows. Twelve is the Generational band, which is anchor-pinned, so the denominator is a structural constant
figures.query: top 12 by rt, intersected with the ballon_dor honour rows

figures.claim: the VV Score of the one Ballon d'Or season the Index does not place in its top three bands
figures.definition: the single ballon_dor row scoring below the 85 band edge. Throws if there is ever more than one, because the page names it in the singular
figures.query: ballon_dor rows with rt < 85

figures.claim: who it was
figures.definition: the same row
figures.query: as above
